items.title: BILL Holdings to be taken private by TPG and Corpay in $6 billion cash deal
items.summary: Investing.com -- BILL Holdings, Inc (NYSE:BILL) has agreed to be taken private by TPG and Corpay Inc (NYSE:CPAY) in an all-cash deal valued at approximately $6.0 billion, capping a prolonged period of activist pressure and valuation compression for the payments automation provider. Under the terms of the definitive agreement, stockholders will receive $63.25 per share, representing a 31% premium to the company’s 60-day volume-weighted average price prior to initial media reports of sale talks.
